objective: Attribute the unchanged M46 cross-TCAD peak at n23, Vd=0.05 V, Vg=0.05 V using default BGN-on self-consistent states, adjacent-gate controls, and a matched low-NWell device control.

matched_low_nwell_control.matching_rule: same Lg, GOxTime, and LDD dose as n23; NWell is the only process-grid factor changed

sequence: drain continuation to 0.05 V at Vg=0 V
gate continuation on the exact 0.00, 0.05, 0.10 V lattice

vela.initial_state_source: frozen M8 Vd=0.05 V drain-ramp accepted state for each device

potential_barrier.support: Silicon/Oxide interface nodes with lateral coordinate in [-0.3, 0.0] um
potential_barrier.electrostatic_proxy: source-contact median electrostatic potential minus minimum interface electrostatic potential
potential_barrier.qf_referenced_proxy: maximum(electron quasi-Fermi potential minus electrostatic potential)

carrier_concentrations.comparison: signed log10(Vela/Sentaurus) with median, p95 absolute, maximum absolute, and barrier-node values

srh_source.comparison: signed source, absolute magnitude, spatial correlation, and integrated generation/recombination current

quasi_fermi_state.vela_coordinate_requirement: absolute quasi-Fermi value plus preserved reference and increment columns

contact_flux.comparison: signed A/um, magnitude ratio, and source-plus-drain balance

attribution_rules.primary_comparison: Vela minus Sentaurus at n23, Vd=0.05 V, Vg=0.05 V
attribution_rules.adjacent_gate_test: compare the target discrepancy with the exact Vg=0.00 V and 0.10 V states in each solver
attribution_rules.nwell_control_test: compare n23 against matched n19 at every gate point and difference the cross-solver discrepancies
attribution_rules.target_localization: a metric may be called target-localized only when the n23 Vg=0.05 discrepancy is an interior extremum relative to both adjacent gates and exceeds the matched n19 discrepancy in the same direction
attribution_rules.causal_claim_guard: state correlation alone is descriptive; the report must separate observed state mismatch, current-consistent mechanism, and unresolved residual
attribution_rules.outcome_policy: a null or mixed attribution is a valid completed result

forbidden_work: global HFS parameter scans or default tuning
BGN, SRH, mobility, contact, solver, or production-default changes
rewriting M8, M45, or M46 artifacts
deliverables: regression test for contract and evidence invariants
